# Permissions MG4Link may declare. A manifest permission missing here fails CI.
# One full permission name per line, '#' starts a comment. Say why next to each
# group: this list is the reviewed answer to "what can this app do to the car".

# --- Projection link: Bluetooth discovery, the car's Wi-Fi hotspot, USB ---
android.permission.BLUETOOTH
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADMIN
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT
# car flavor: confirm the system pairing challenge after Android Auto authenticates it.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_PRIVILEGED
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN
android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE
android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE
android.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
android.permission.CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE
# Phone internet over USB, ABRP telemetry (opt-in), update check, crash report.
android.permission.INTERNET
# car flavor: claim the phone on the head unit's USB bus.
android.permission.MANAGE_USB

# --- Location: wireless discovery and the GPS forwarded to the phone ---
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION

# --- Audio, voice assistant, calls ---
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
android.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS
android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE

# --- Vehicle data read for Google Maps' battery estimate (read-only) ---
android.car.permission.CAR_ENERGY
android.car.permission.CAR_ENERGY_PORTS
android.car.permission.CAR_SPEED
android.car.permission.CAR_VENDOR_EXTENSION

# --- Service lifecycle and projection UI ---
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
android.permission.USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT
android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
android.permission.BROADCAST_STICKY
android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS
android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
# Lets the car build copy exported logs to the root of a removable USB stick.
android.permission.WRITE_MEDIA_STORAGE

# --- High risk: system-user capabilities (car flavor, platform signature) ---
# Exported logs include other apps' Android Auto lines.
android.permission.READ_LOGS
# Silent self-update (OTA) and removal of the former relay package.
android.permission.INSTALL_PACKAGES
android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES
android.permission.DELETE_PACKAGES
# Stops the car's own Android Auto while MG4Link runs (never disables it).
android.permission.FORCE_STOP_PACKAGES

# --- Signature-protected permissions MG4Link declares for its own components ---
com.allgo.app.androidauto.permission.USER_DISCONNECT
# signature: platform-signed apps reserve a strip at the side of Android Auto (#69).
com.allgo.app.androidauto.permission.RESERVE_MARGIN
# signature: platform-signed apps say a sentence to the phone's assistant (#71).
com.allgo.app.androidauto.permission.ASSISTANT_COMMAND
com.andrerinas.openheadunit.permission.NAVIGATION_UPDATE
